title: Multi-activity quest (gather, craft, shelter)
description: Three-actor quest family: gather logs, craft a crafting table, and establish a small shelter compete for actors, materials, and time. The setup creates concurrent useful activities without centrally assigning division of labor, partners, or any social response.

asymmetries.description: Actor A begins nearer the densest log cluster; the others begin with longer travel to the same wood.
asymmetries.subject: log_cluster_proximity

asymmetries.description: Actor B begins knowing a flatter clearing suitable for shelter; the others may discover it only through observation or exploration.
asymmetries.subject: shelter_clearing_location

asymmetries.description: Actor C begins holding a crafting table item that can be placed as a shared station; the others begin without that item.
asymmetries.subject: crafting_table_item

nodes.title: Gather logs
nodes.description: Collect logs needed for crafting and shelter blocks.

nodes.title: Place crafting station
nodes.description: Place or craft a crafting table usable as a shared station in the world.

nodes.title: Craft early tools
nodes.description: Convert materials at a station into planks, sticks, or simple tools.

nodes.title: Establish shelter
nodes.description: Place enough blocks for a small shelter footprint before night pressure rises.

edges.description: Crafting a station from scratch needs logs; placing an existing table does not, but both compete for attention.
A placed station unlocks efficient conversion of materials into tools.
Shelter blocks consume the same wood pool used for crafting.
Tool crafting and continued gathering compete for actor time and material.
Shelter work and tool crafting compete for the same actors and wood budget.
A placed station near a clearing can anchor both crafting and shelter activity without assigning who uses it.

required_capabilities.gap_reason: Early-tool crafting is a useful competing activity in this quest graph, but no current-run craft_wooden_pickaxe capability report is required to declare the family.

interaction_opportunities.description: Actors may observe a crafting-table item or placed station and choose to place, use, request access, ignore, or pursue another activity.
Actors may observe the same limited wood pool being pulled toward crafting versus shelter and choose how, whether, or with whom to act.
Actors who learn the flatter clearing may leave traces or be observed by others without any required disclosure or joint plan.

material_stakes.description: Logs and planks used for tools or shelter reduce what remains for other quest activities.
Holding or placing the crafting table changes station access for whoever can reach it.
Shelter blocks change available cover and later construction options for all actors near the clearing.
A placed crafting table is shared-world infrastructure that alters conversion options without assigning users.

provenance.notes: C2 multi-activity quest family. Competing useful activities; no prescribed division of labor or social response.
